final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(*) AS c FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), t AS (SELECT st, c, c * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM j) AS sh FROM j), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS avg_sh FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.c) AS avg_count, AVG(t.sh) AS avg_share, AVG(t.sh - a.avg_sh) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.sh > a.avg_sh
